label: copy-phase input y, mid-sequence (recall 3-5, not near end)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (99.7% of mass) when the fed-back input token is y (a repeat of an original y). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on first occurrences of y. Gated by position: active mainly at recall_idx 3-5 (peak 4, absolute t 11-13) and silent when only 0-1 outputs remain, so short sequences (L<=5) rarely activate. Top activations (~2.6-2.9) are y as original token 2-3 in L=8-9 sequences, recalled at t=12. Earlier copy-phase y (recall_idx<=2) does not fire; late y in long sequences fires weakly. About 26% of predicted steps are still inactive, so the positional gating is only approximated.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: y, l, a, x; t=11: y, l, x, a; t=13: y, a, l, i) and the previous input (most: m, 0, h, d, r, i; least: v, q, <DEL>, n); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=12.
